item.title: Evaluating Conversation Agents
item.description: A conversation has no single right answer. What breaks when you try to measure it anyway, what to put in place instead, how far an LLM judge gets you, and where humans still sit in the loop.

item.title: How We Manage LLM Costs Across Billions of Tokens
item.description: Thousands of AI interviews a day, dozens of teams calling LLM APIs, one sane bill. Here's the system.

item.title: Speculative Routing: An Architecture for Voice Agents
item.description: A production architecture for scaling voice agents beyond demos - to a million real conversations.

item.title: Finding Structure in Time: Decoding the 1990 Paper
item.description: Decoding Jeffrey Elman's 1990 paper 'Finding Structure in Time' - how a tiny recurrent network discovered linguistic structure just by predicting the next word, and why that idea underpins today's LLMs.
